source: Owner Chartink scans 2026-11-20: screenshots config/strategies/ChartInk + scan names from tmp/ChartInk1.mp4. Review: docs/strategies/chartink-analysis-2026-11-20.md. Every entry starts with the owner liquidity floor.

strategies.name: GMAnalysis - EMA 9 x 45
strategies.description: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 45
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(ema(close, 9), ema(close, 45)))

strategies.name: GMAnalysis - EMA 9 x 200
strategies.description: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 200
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(ema(close, 9), ema(close, 200)))

strategies.name: GMAnalysis - MACD up below zero + RSI3
strategies.description: MACD turning up while MACD or signal <= 0, RSI(3) >= 80
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and ((cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) or macd_hist(close) >= 0) and (macd(close) <= 0 or macd_signal(close) <= 0) and rsi(close, 3) >= 80)

strategies.name: MACD Cross below 0
strategies.description: Daily MACD crosses above signal while below zero
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) and macd(close) < 0)

strategies.name: Weekly MACD below 0
strategies.description: Weekly MACD crosses above signal while below zero
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 4)[1] >= 750000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) and macd(close) < 0)

strategies.name: Excellent - Entry A - MACD Reversal
strategies.description: MACD crosses above signal below zero, close above EMA 21/50/200
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) and macd(close) < 0 and close > ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and close > ema(close, 21))
strategies.notes: market cap > 3000 cr replaced by the liquidity floor

strategies.name: Claude Predictive MACD
strategies.description: Histogram below zero but rising 3 days, uptrend, volume 1.5x, RSI 40-55 and rising
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and macd_hist(close) < 0 and macd_hist(close) > macd_hist(close)[1] and macd_hist(close)[1] > macd_hist(close)[2] and macd_hist(close)[2] > macd_hist(close)[3] and close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20) and rsi(close, 14) > rsi(close, 14)[1] and between(rsi(close, 14), 40, 55))
strategies.notes: market cap > 5000 cr replaced by the liquidity floor

strategies.name: 5 day daily 5% up
strategies.description: 5 days in a row each close >= 4.9% above the previous; no locked (high = low) day, volume expanding
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (all_of(close >= 1.049 * close[1], 5) and all_of(high > low, 5) and volume > sma(volume, 20))
strategies.notes: circuit guard added: a locked upper-circuit day (high = low) cannot be bought at the next open

strategies.name: 5 day price increase
strategies.description: 5 higher closes in a row
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (all_of(close > close[1], 5))

strategies.name: SS-2Bullish-Daily
strategies.description: 3 rising closes, yesterday RSI(3) > 80, EMA 20 reclaim or EMA13 > EMA20, volume >= 2x
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and close[2] > close[3] and rsi(close, 3)[1] > 80 and ((close > ema(close, 20) and open < ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: SS-2Bullish-Hourly
strategies.description: 2 closes above prior highs, RSI(3) > 80, EMA 20 clause, volume >= 2x (daily candles)
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close[1] > high[2] and close > high[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80 and ((close > ema(close, 20) and open < ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20))
strategies.notes: Chartink also has 'Copy - Two bullish candle latest close grt pdh' with the same opening clause

strategies.name: SS-2Bearish-Daily
strategies.description: 3 falling closes and lows, yesterday RSI(3) < 20, EMA 20 break or EMA13 < EMA20, volume >= 2x
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close[2] < close[3] and close[1] < close[2] and low[1] < low[2] and close < close[1] and low < low[1] and rsi(close, 3)[1] < 20 and ((close < ema(close, 20) and open > ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: D-VolumeSpike - Long
strategies.description: Volume > 2x the highest of the previous 15 days, green day
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (volume > 2 * highest(volume, 15)[1] and close > open)

strategies.name: D-VolumeSpike - Short
strategies.description: Volume > 2x the highest of the previous 15 days, red day
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (volume > 2 * highest(volume, 15)[1] and close < open)

strategies.name: Volume Based Bulltrade
strategies.description: Yesterday: very low volume (< half EMA 20 volume) with RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (volume[1] < ema(volume, 20)[1] / 2 and rsi(close, 3)[1] > 80)

strategies.name: 9 gt 20 at 45 deg
strategies.description: EMA 9 > EMA 20 and EMA 9's 1-day rise > 45% of the day's range
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 20) and (ema(close, 9) - ema(close, 9)[1]) * 100 > 45 * (high - low))

strategies.name: 9 gt 20 at 45 deg (ATR slope)
strategies.description: EMA 9 > EMA 20 and EMA 9 rose >= 0.25 ATR per day over 3 days (scale-free variant)
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 9) - ema(close, 9)[3] >= 0.75 * atr(14))

strategies.name: JULY23_DAILY_BULL_BBSCAN
strategies.description: Daily candle reclaims EMA 50 in a downtrend (EMA13 < 50 < 200)
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and open < ema(close, 50))

strategies.name: Bearish EMA Crossover
strategies.description: EMA 13 crosses below EMA n with close below it
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_below(ema(close, 13), ema(close, $n)) and close < ema(close, $n))

strategies.name: SS_Portfolio_Entry
strategies.description: Below EMA 200 recovery: 2 higher closes, above EMA 13, RSI(300) >= 49, volume up
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close < ema(close, 200) and close > close[1] and close > close[2] and close > ema(close, 13) and rsi(close, 300) >= 49 and volume > sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: SS_Portfolio_Entry_Weekly
strategies.description: Weekly: below EMA 200 recovery, 2 higher closes, above EMA 13, RSI(300) >= 49, volume up
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 4)[1] >= 750000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close < ema(close, 200) and close > close[1] and close > close[2] and close > ema(close, 13) and rsi(close, 300) >= 49 and volume > ema(volume, 20))

strategies.name: DS - Bollinger Band Bullish Breakout - Daily
strategies.description: Candle crosses SMA 20 from below and pierces the upper band; d/w/m RSI >= 59
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (high > bb_upper(close, 20, 2) and close >= sma(close, 20) and open <= sma(close, 20) and rsi(close, 14) >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1w") >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1mo") >= 59)

strategies.name: DS - Bollinger Band Bullish Breakout - Daily (follow-through)
strategies.description: Day after an SMA 20 cross closes higher; d/w/m RSI >= 59
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close >= close[1] and close[1] >= sma(close, 20)[1] and open[1] <= sma(close, 20)[1] and rsi(close, 14) >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1w") >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1mo") >= 59)
strategies.notes: branches 2 and 3 of the scan merged (exactly equivalent: high above or below the band)

strategies.name: GM_Longterm_InvestmentStrategy
strategies.description: Monthly RSI(3) < 20 (deeply oversold) + 2 up days
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (htf(rsi(close, 3), "1mo") < 20 and close[1] > close[2] and close > close[1])

strategies.name: GM Bullish Daily Pinbar Bull Candle
strategies.description: Green hammer: lower wick >= 2x body and >= 1.75x upper wick
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (open - low) >= 1.75 * (high - close))

strategies.name: GM Bullish Daily Pinbar Candle Today
strategies.description: Hammer (green or red) that makes a lower low
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (((close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (open - low) >= 1.75 * (high - close)) or (close < open and (close - low) >= 2 * (open - close) and (close - low) >= 1.75 * (high - open))) and low < low[1])

strategies.name: GM Bullish Daily Pinbar Candle - Final
strategies.description: Hammer 2 days ago, yesterday closes above its high, today higher close
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (((close[2] < open[2] and (close[2] - low[2]) >= 2 * (open[2] - close[2]) and (close[2] - low[2]) >= 1.75 * (high[2] - open[2])) or (close[2] > open[2] and (open[2] - low[2]) >= 2 * (close[2] - open[2]) and (open[2] - low[2]) >= 1.75 * (high[2] - close[2]))) and (min(open[1], close[1]) - low[1]) >= 1.75 * (high[1] - max(open[1], close[1])) and close[1] > high[2] and close > close[1])

strategies.name: GM Bearish Daily Pinbar Candle
strategies.description: Shooting star after 2 green days, gap-up open fails
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close < open and (high - open) >= 2 * (open - close) and (high - open) >= 1.75 * (close - low) and close[1] > open[1] and close[2] > open[2] and close < close[1] and open > close[1])
strategies.notes: Chartink scan cannot fire as saved (branch A: '3 days ago close > 3 days ago close'; branch B: close > open and open > close)

strategies.name: 44EMA Low
strategies.description: Daily candle touches EMA 44 of lows
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (high > ema(low, 44) and low <= ema(low, 44))

strategies.name: 44EMA High
strategies.description: Daily candle touches EMA 44 of highs
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (high > ema(high, 44) and low <= ema(high, 44))

strategies.name: Entry Type B — Trend Continuation Pullback
strategies.description: Uptrend pullback to EMA 21, MACD hist > 0, RSI 45-62, quiet volume, turnover > 10 cr
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > ema(close, 200) and ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 21) and ema(close, 21) > ema(close, 50) and close > ema(close, 9) and low <= 1.02 * ema(close, 21) and low >= 0.97 * ema(close, 21) and macd_hist(close) > 0 and between(rsi(close, 14), 45, 62) and volume < 1.2 * sma(volume, 20) and volume * close > 100000000 and close > 0.97 * close[1])
strategies.notes: market cap > 2000 cr replaced by the liquidity floor

strategies.name: Near EMA200 - cross above
strategies.description: Close crosses above EMA 200
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_above(close, ema(close, 200)))

strategies.name: Near EMA200 - cross below
strategies.description: Close crosses below EMA 200
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (cross_below(close, ema(close, 200)))

strategies.name: GM W Pattern
strategies.description: Bollinger W-bottom: a low below the lower band in the last 10 days, now holding above it, RSI < 50, open above yesterday's open
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (lowest(low - bb_lower(close, 20, 2), 10)[1] < 0 and low > bb_lower(close, 20, 2) and rsi(close, 14) < 50 and open > open[1])
strategies.notes: saved scan is 'lower band < SMA 20' (always true) + RSI < 50 + open > prev open; the W-bottom reading comes from the scan name - confirm

strategies.name: GR - Intraday buy
strategies.description: 15m: close above previous high, two green bars, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (close > high[1] and close > open and close[1] > open[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80)

strategies.name: 5 Min Golden Cross
strategies.description: 5m: EMA 4 > 9 > 18, green bar, higher close, daily RSI(3) > 75
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 4) > ema(close, 9) and ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 18) and close > open and close > close[1] and htf(rsi(close, 3), "1d") > 75)

strategies.name: Sowmya 3 min Strategy
strategies.description: 5m (scan is 3m): two rising closes, daily volume > 125000, daily RSI(3) > 79
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and htf(volume, "1d") > 125000 and htf(rsi(close, 3), "1d") > 79)

strategies.name: 15 min Volume Shockers - Up
strategies.description: 15m: 5% up bar on 1.5x volume
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close > 1.05 * close[1])

strategies.name: 15 min Volume Shockers - Up (ATR)
strategies.description: 15m: bar up >= 2.5 ATR on 1.5x volume (scale-free variant)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close - close[1] >= 2.5 * atr(14))

strategies.name: 15 min Volume Shockers - Down
strategies.description: 15m: 5% down bar on 1.5x volume
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close < 0.95 * close[1])

strategies.name: 15 min Volume Shockers - Down (ATR)
strategies.description: 15m: bar down >= 2.5 ATR on 1.5x volume (scale-free variant)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close[1] - close >= 2.5 * atr(14))

strategies.name: New BB 15 Min
strategies.description: Candle reclaims EMA 50 in a downtrend (EMA13 < 50 < 200)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and open < ema(close, 50) and close >= ema(close, 50))
strategies.notes: daily 10% filter of the scan never binds (identical firings) - dropped; 60m added

strategies.name: July23_15MIN_BuLL_BBSCAN
strategies.description: Previous 15m bar reclaimed EMA 50 in a downtrend, current bar closes higher (3m confirmation mapped to 15m)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13)[1] < ema(close, 50)[1] and ema(close, 50)[1] < ema(close, 200)[1] and open[1] < ema(close, 50)[1] and close[1] >= ema(close, 50)[1] and close > close[1])

strategies.name: HA-13-50-200
strategies.description: Heikin-Ashi close crosses above EMA 50 in a downtrend (signal on HA, fills on real prices)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and cross_above(ha_close, ema(close, 50)))

strategies.name: BB 15 min Short strategy
strategies.description: 15m red candle cuts EMA 50 down (EMA13 crossed below 50, or daily EMA13 > 50)
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and ((cross_below(ema(close, 13), ema(close, 50)) or htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 50), "1d")) and close < ema(close, 50) and open > ema(close, 50))

strategies.name: Bearish EMA Crossover (intraday)
strategies.description: Intraday: EMA 13 crosses below EMA n with close below it
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (cross_below(ema(close, 13), ema(close, $n)) and close < ema(close, $n))

strategies.name: BB 100-200-400 30 min - GM
strategies.description: 30m: EMA 100 crosses above EMA 200, EMA 200 >= EMA 400, EMAs within 5%
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (cross_above(ema(close, 100), ema(close, 200)) and ema(close, 200) >= ema(close, 400) and ((ema(close, 200) - ema(close, 400)) <= 0.05 * ema(close, 200) or (ema(close, 100) - ema(close, 200)) <= 0.05 * ema(close, 100)))

strategies.name: SS-Swing-1hr-Bullish
strategies.description: 1h + daily stack 13 > 20 > 100, 1h volume up, breaks yesterday's high
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and high >= prev_day_high())

strategies.name: SS-Swing-1hr-Bearish
strategies.description: 1h + daily stack 13 < 20 < 100, 1h volume up, breaks yesterday's low
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) < ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and low < prev_day_low())

strategies.name: SS - 3 MIN 2BULL-CANDLE
strategies.description: 5m (scan is 3m) + 15m stack 13 > 20 > 50 > 100, open = low, breakout bar, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) > ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") and close > open and open == low and close[1] > open[1] and close > high[1] and low > low[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80)

strategies.name: Final-SS-GM-3Min-Bearish
strategies.description: 5m (scan is 3m) + 15m stack 100 > 20 > 13, volume up, new day low
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (ema(close, 100) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 13) and htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and low <= session_low)

strategies.name: Bollinger Feb25
strategies.description: 1h: tight 20-bar base (low within 5% of SMA 20), close above the highest upper band, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (rsi(close, 3) > 80 and (sma(close, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) < 0.05 * sma(close, 20) and close > highest(bb_upper(close, 20, 2), 20))

strategies.name: GM Bearish RSI Divergence - Hourly
strategies.description: 1h: price above a bar 1-5 back while RSI(14) is lower, RSI >= 60
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (rsi(close, 14) >= 60 and ((close > close[1] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[1]) or (close > close[2] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[2]) or (close > close[3] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[3]) or (close > close[4] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[4]) or (close > close[5] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[5])))

strategies.name: 5 Red candles - 5 min - Long (opening drive)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, opening drive window, long side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close < open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 0, 25))

strategies.name: 5 Red candles - 5 min - Long (midday)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, midday window, long side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close < open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 40, 310))

strategies.name: 5 Red candles - 5 min - Short (opening drive)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, opening drive window, short side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close < open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 0, 25))

strategies.name: 5 Red candles - 5 min - Short (midday)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, midday window, short side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close < open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 40, 310))

strategies.name: 5 Green candles - 5 min - Long (opening drive)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, opening drive window, long side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close > open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 0, 25))

strategies.name: 5 Green candles - 5 min - Long (midday)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, midday window, long side
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (all_of(close > open, 5) and between(minute_of_session, 40, 310))

strategies.name: 5 Green candles - 5 min - Short (opening drive)
strategies.description: 5 consecutive candles, opening drive window, short side
